  if bit32 and bit32.bxor then return bit32.bxor end
  if bit and bit.bxor then return bit.bxor end

      local x,y=a%2,b%2
      if x~=y then r=r+p end
      a=(a-x)/2 b=(b-y)/2 p=p*2
    end
    return r
  end
end)()
